name: EA-3DGS
definition: An enhanced 3DGS model for large-scale scene representation that uses an adaptive tetrahedral mesh for initialization, structure-aware pruning/densification for stability, and vector quantization for compression.
summary: EA-3DGS is a large-scale 3D scene representation method that uses adaptive tetrahedral meshes and vector quantization to enable stable, single-GPU training without the global information loss of partitioning-based approaches.
